title: New in AWS Quick: More capable flows, an updated web experience, and agents that work together
summary: AWS Quick is the AI workspace built only for work. Today we're releasing updates that help your team get more done: build and run business-process flows in chat, triage your day in the updated web app, get more complete answers from multiple agents at once, and connect new data s
reason: Announcement of updates to AWS Quick, a proprietary AI workspace (flows, web app, multi-agent answers). It is a non-model product launch, not a named model release, reported via AWS's own blog announcement on aws.amazon.com.
